item.title: My iptables Rule Matched 0 Packets in 9.8 GB
item.description:
After a week of Windows firewall rules that listed fine and enforced nothing, I went back to the Linux side of ephemerd feeling pretty good about it. iptables is the boring, well-understood one. Then I looked at the packet counters on a live node and found a rule that had never matched a packet in its life, on a node that had pushed 9.8 GB through the same chain.

The rules I thought I had

Job containers sit on a CNI bridge, 10.88.0.0/16, with the host on 10.88.0.1. ephemerd puts its egress policy in its own chain, EPHEMERD-FORWARD, jumped to from FORWARD for anything to or from the container subnet. From a live node:
